passage: A student studying weather records claims that rainfall in the town of Millford decreased each month from April to June last year. The table shows the town's monthly rainfall.
stem: Which choice most effectively uses data from the table to support the student's claim?
choices: Rainfall fell from 82 mm in April to 64 mm in May and then to 31 mm in June.
June had the least rainfall of the three months, with only 31 mm in total.
Rainfall in May was 64 mm, which was less than the 82 mm that fell in April.
April had 82 mm of rainfall, which was the most of the three months shown.
steps: "Decreased each month" needs April→May and May→June to both fall.
The other choices give only one month or one step.
key: Match the evidence to every part of the claim.
